Bash(curl -s "https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GBPUSD=X?interval=1m&range=1d" -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36" -H "Accept: application/json")

Bash(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); r=d['chart']['result'][0]; print\('price:', r['meta']['regularMarketPrice']\); print\('prevClose:', r['meta']['chartPreviousClose']\); ts=r.get\('timestamp',[]\); c=r['indicators']['quote'][0].get\('close',[]\); print\('candles available:', len\(ts\)\); print\('last 3 closes:', [x for x in c if x][-3:]\)")

Bash(node -e "let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{const r=JSON.parse\(d\).chart.result[0]; console.log\('price:', r.meta.regularMarketPrice, 'prevClose:', r.meta.chartPreviousClose, 'candles:', r.timestamp?.length, 'last3:', r.indicators.quote[0].close?.filter\(Boolean\).slice\(-3\)\);}\)")
